narrative.overview:
The user-selected direction is personable, spacious, and literary. Times New Roman carries the whole voice on one plain dark sage ground; cream type, italic emphasis, and generous space establish hierarchy. The interface feels like an introduction to a person, with professional detail available at a quieter scale.

Flat, unboxed content and fine rules keep the page easy to read. Small underlined links and native disclosures supply the interaction vocabulary. The selected cream-line flower and cottage study shares this restrained palette; its scattered-ink reveal is a local expressive moment, rather than a general entrance-animation system. The implementation and the confirmed direction in `.impeccable/surfaces/home.md` are the authority for these rules.
keyCharacteristics: One plain dark sage ground with cream and muted secondary type.
Times New Roman throughout, with a large greeting and italic name.
Generous space, fine rules, and unboxed content.
Underlined text actions and keyboard-accessible native disclosures.
A selected illustrative ink study with replay and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Continuous Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the approved dark sage ground uninterrupted; organize content with spacing, typography, and fine rules.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Use Times New Roman across expressive type, prose, metadata, and controls; scale and spacing do the work.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve the single ground and unboxed reading surface; interaction states use underlines and focus outlines.

dos: Do retain the approved dark sage ground, cream primary type, and quiet secondary copy.
Do use Times New Roman throughout and let size, italic emphasis, and space create hierarchy.
Do keep text links underlined and keyboard focus visible.
Do use native disclosures for expandable experience and community detail.
Do preserve the selected study's replay, illustrative labelling, and immediate completed state for reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce card grids, raised panels, or elaborate backgrounds into this restrained world.
Don't replace the personable greeting with a role-and-date-led first impression.
Don't turn modest contact links into oversized filled buttons.
Don't add a portrait or résumé control without a supplied, approved asset.
Don't present generated illustration as Isabella's own artwork or describe its reveal as authentic stroke order.
